fusions.name: Shut the Door
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Inescapable] for 6 seconds, unable to teleport or step aside. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Crossfire Pen
fusions.desc: Fires a ring of rounds that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Snare
fusions.desc: Sets a spring-gun at the nearest enemy. It stays armed for 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off for 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Fish in a Barrel
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
